responsibility: Declares the FreeBSD-specific driver options recognized by GCC’s option machinery, including assert/defsym/rpath/soname plus posix, profile, pthread, and rdynamic. It is the option-table companion to the FreeBSD spec headers, providing command-line metadata rather than implementing the specs themselves.
same_name_distinction: Within the FreeBSD same-name pair, this file only declares command-line option metadata such as assert, defsym, rpath, soname, posix, profile, pthread, and rdynamic; freebsd.h is the file that defines the corresponding target configuration and specs.
